NSCameraUsageDescription: Thuluth uses the camera when you photograph a meal so it can suggest what is on the plate.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Thuluth uses a photo you choose to log a meal and suggest what is on the plate.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Thuluth uses the microphone when you ask the assistant a question by voice. The recording is turned into text and not kept.
